title: Coin of Mammon
summary: Use one Coin of Mammon in Helsik’s ritual at the Devil’s Fee to open the House of Hope portal.

fields.Ritual: Use one coin as one of the ritual components at the Devil’s Fee.
fields.Acquisition: Helsik’s pouch can contain a common coin; the gilded chest in her room contains a story-item version.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
